name: clerk
description: Experimental: manage Clerk (clerk.com) authentication infrastructure as code: allowlists, blocklists, JWT templates, organizations and their roles and permissions, OAuth applications, SAML connections, API keys, machines and webhooks.

clerk:index:AllowlistIdentifier.description: A Clerk allowlist entry. When sign-ups are restricted to the allowlist, only allowlisted email addresses, phone numbers and web3 wallets can sign up. Entries cannot be updated: changing any input replaces the entry.

identifier.description: The email address, phone number or web3 wallet to allow, for example an email address, a phone number, a web3 wallet or an email wildcard like *@example.com. Changing this forces a new resource.

identifierType.description: The kind of identifier: email_address, phone_number or web3_wallet.

notify.description: Whether to send an invitation email to the identifier when the entry is created. Only applies to email addresses. Clerk does not report this back, so it is only tracked from the program: an entry that was imported, or that was created without it, has no recorded value, and setting it then changes nothing. Changing a recorded value forces a new resource (the old entry is deleted first). Removing the property after a value was recorded changes nothing.

updatedAt.description: When the entry was last updated (RFC 3339).

identifier.description: The email address, phone number or web3 wallet to allow, for example an email address, a phone number, a web3 wallet or an email wildcard like *@example.com. Changing this forces a new resource.

notify.description: Whether to send an invitation email to the identifier when the entry is created. Only applies to email addresses. Changing a recorded value forces a new resource (the old entry is deleted first). Removing the property after a value was recorded changes nothing.

clerk:index:ApiKey.description: A Clerk API key for machine-to-machine authentication. The secret value is available only from the output of the resource. The name, type and creator of a key cannot be changed, so changing them replaces the key and issues a new secret.

claims.description: JSON object of custom claims. Key order and whitespace do not matter: the value is normalised, so reordering keys is not a change.

createdBy.description: ID of the user that created the key. Can only be set at creation, so changing it forces a new resource.

effectiveCreatedBy.description: The creator Clerk reports for the key, if any.

effectiveSubject.description: The subject Clerk reports for the key.

effectiveType.description: The key type Clerk is using, including its default.

expiration.description: When the key expires (RFC 3339), if it has an expiration.

lastUsedAt.description: When the key was last used (RFC 3339), if it has been used.

name.description: Name of the API key. Changing this forces a new resource.

revoked.description: Whether the key has been revoked.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to the API key.

secondsUntilExpiration.description: Number of seconds until the key expires. Write-only: Clerk reports an expiration timestamp instead, in expiration.

secret.description: The API key secret. Secret. It is read when the key is created or imported.

subject.description: ID of the user, organization, machine or SCIM subject the key belongs to. Clerk requires a subject when the key is created. The effective value is in effectiveSubject.

type.description: Type of the API key. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveType. Changing this forces a new resource.

updatedAt.description: When the key was last updated (RFC 3339).

claims.description: JSON object of custom claims. Key order and whitespace do not matter: the value is normalised, so reordering keys is not a change.

createdBy.description: ID of the user that created the key. Can only be set at creation, so changing it forces a new resource.

name.description: Name of the API key. Changing this forces a new resource.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to the API key.

secondsUntilExpiration.description: Number of seconds until the key expires. Write-only: Clerk reports an expiration timestamp instead, in expiration.

subject.description: ID of the user, organization, machine or SCIM subject the key belongs to. Clerk requires a subject when the key is created. The effective value is in effectiveSubject.

type.description: Type of the API key. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveType. Changing this forces a new resource.

clerk:index:Application.description: A Clerk application, managed through the Clerk Platform API. The Platform API is in beta and must be enabled by Clerk for your account; configure it with the clerk:platformApiKey provider setting. Only the name, logo and favicon can be updated in place; every other input forces replacement. The API does not return domain, proxyPath, environmentTypes, template, logo or favicon on reads, so those are kept as configured. Import with the application ID (for example: pulumi import clerk:index/application:Application app app_123); an imported application has an empty name until it is set in the program.

domain.description: Custom domain for the application. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

environmentTypes.description: Environment types to create, for example ["development", "production"]. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

favicon.description: Base64-encoded favicon image content. Write-only: the API does not return it. Removing it deletes the favicon.

instances.description: The instances (environments) of the application, with their keys. The whole list is secret because it carries each instance secret key.

logo.description: Base64-encoded logo image content (use the language's file-to-base64 helper). Write-only: the API does not return it. Removing it deletes the logo.

name.description: Name of the application.

proxyPath.description: Proxy path for the application. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

template.description: Application template slug. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

domain.description: Custom domain for the application. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

environmentTypes.description: Environment types to create, for example ["development", "production"]. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

favicon.description: Base64-encoded favicon image content. Write-only: the API does not return it. Removing it deletes the favicon.

logo.description: Base64-encoded logo image content (use the language's file-to-base64 helper). Write-only: the API does not return it. Removing it deletes the logo.

name.description: Name of the application.

proxyPath.description: Proxy path for the application. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

template.description: Application template slug. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

clerk:index:ApplicationSettings.description: The organization feature settings of a Clerk instance (the instance behind the clerk:apiKey). This is a singleton: only one can exist per instance, and its ID is always application_settings. The Backend API has no read endpoint for these settings, so refresh and import read the current values by sending an empty update. Optional inputs left unset are not managed: Clerk keeps its current value, which is shown in the matching current* output. Deleting the resource disables organizations on the instance, as the Terraform provider did. Import with the ID application_settings.

adminDeleteEnabled.description: Whether organization admins can delete organizations. Leave unset to keep Clerk's current value; see currentAdminDeleteEnabled.

creatorRole.description: The role assigned to the creator of a new organization.

currentAdminDeleteEnabled.description: Whether organization admins can currently delete organizations.

currentDomainsEnabled.description: Whether domain-based organization enrollment is currently enabled.

currentMaxAllowedMemberships.description: The default maximum number of memberships per organization Clerk currently applies.

domainsDefaultRole.description: The default role of users added through domain enrollment.

domainsEnabled.description: Whether domain-based organization enrollment is enabled. Leave unset to keep Clerk's current value; see currentDomainsEnabled.

enableOrganizations.description: Whether organizations are enabled for this instance.

maxAllowedMemberships.description: Default maximum number of memberships per organization. Leave unset to keep Clerk's current value; see currentMaxAllowedMemberships.

maxAllowedPermissions.description: Maximum number of permissions allowed per organization.

maxAllowedRoles.description: Maximum number of roles allowed per organization.

adminDeleteEnabled.description: Whether organization admins can delete organizations. Leave unset to keep Clerk's current value; see currentAdminDeleteEnabled.

domainsEnabled.description: Whether domain-based organization enrollment is enabled. Leave unset to keep Clerk's current value; see currentDomainsEnabled.

enableOrganizations.description: Whether organizations are enabled for this instance.

maxAllowedMemberships.description: Default maximum number of memberships per organization. Leave unset to keep Clerk's current value; see currentMaxAllowedMemberships.

clerk:index:BlocklistIdentifier.description: A Clerk blocklist entry. Blocklisted email addresses, phone numbers and web3 wallets cannot be used to sign up. Entries cannot be updated: changing the identifier replaces the entry.

identifier.description: The email address, phone number or web3 wallet to block. Changing this forces a new resource.

identifierType.description: The kind of identifier: email_address, phone_number or web3_wallet.

updatedAt.description: When the entry was last updated (RFC 3339).

identifier.description: The email address, phone number or web3 wallet to block. Changing this forces a new resource.

clerk:index:Domain.description: A domain on a Clerk application, managed through the Clerk Platform API. The Platform API is in beta and must be enabled by Clerk for your account; configure it with the clerk:platformApiKey provider setting. Domains cannot be updated: changing any input replaces the domain. The resource ID is <applicationId>/<domainId>; import with that ID (for example: pulumi import clerk:index/domain:Domain d app_123/dmn_456). The API does not return proxyPath, so it is kept as configured.

applicationId.description: The ID of the application this domain belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

cnameTargets.description: The CNAME records to create in DNS for this domain.

frontendApiUrl.description: The frontend API URL of this domain.

isProviderDomain.description: Whether this is a provider domain.

isSatellite.description: Whether this is a satellite domain.

name.description: The domain name, for example app.example.com. Changing this forces a new resource.

proxyPath.description: Proxy path for the domain. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

applicationId.description: The ID of the application this domain belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

name.description: The domain name, for example app.example.com. Changing this forces a new resource.

proxyPath.description: Proxy path for the domain. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.

clerk:index:InstanceConfig.description: Settings of a Clerk instance, managed through the Platform API (beta, needs the platform API key). Only the keys present in config are managed: other settings of the instance are left alone and are not reported as drift. Singleton per instance: deleting the resource only removes it from Pulumi state and does not reset the instance configuration. Import with the ID <applicationId>/<instanceId>; the imported config is the whole instance configuration.

applicationId.description: The ID of the Clerk application. Changing this forces a new resource.

config.description: JSON object of instance configuration keys and values, for example from JSON.stringify. Key order does not matter. It is a secret because instance configuration can contain provider client secrets.

configVersion.description: The version of the instance configuration, used by Clerk for optimistic concurrency.

instanceId.description: The ID of the Clerk instance. Changing this forces a new resource.

applicationId.description: The ID of the Clerk application. Changing this forces a new resource.

Whether the domain is a satellite domain is fixed at creation: changing it replaces the domain. Import with the domain ID, for example dmn_...

accountsPortalUrl.description: The Accounts Portal URL of this domain.

cnameTargets.description: The DNS CNAME records the domain requires.

developmentOrigin.description: The development origin of the domain, if any.

effectiveIsSatellite.description: Whether Clerk treats the domain as a satellite domain, including when isSatellite is left unset.

frontendApiUrl.description: The Frontend API URL of this domain.

isSatellite.description: Whether this is a satellite domain. Fixed at creation: changing this forces a new resource. Clerk defaults to false.

name.description: The domain name, for example app.example.com.

proxyUrl.description: The proxy URL for the domain.

clerk:index:JwtTemplate.description: A Clerk JWT template: a named set of custom claims, lifetime and signing settings used to mint tokens for third-party integrations.

allowedClockSkew.description: Allowed clock skew in seconds. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveAllowedClockSkew.

claims.description: JSON object of custom claims for the token. Key order and whitespace do not matter: the value is normalised, so reordering keys is not a change.

customSigningKey.description: Whether to sign tokens with signingKey instead of the instance signing key.

effectiveAllowedClockSkew.description: The allowed clock skew in seconds that Clerk is using, including its default.

effectiveCustomSigningKey.description: Whether Clerk signs with a custom signing key.

effectiveLifetime.description: The token lifetime in seconds that Clerk is using, including its default.

effectiveSigningAlgorithm.description: The signing algorithm Clerk is using, including its default.

lifetime.description: Token lifetime in seconds. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveLifetime.

name.description: Name of the JWT template.

signingAlgorithm.description: Signing algorithm, for example RS256 or HS256. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveSigningAlgorithm.

signingKey.description: Custom signing key. Write-only: Clerk never returns it, so it is kept from the program.

updatedAt.description: When the template was last updated (RFC 3339).

allowedClockSkew.description: Allowed clock skew in seconds. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveAllowedClockSkew.

clerk:index:Machine.description: A Clerk machine: a non-human identity that authenticates to the Clerk Backend API with a machine secret key.

defaultTokenTtl.description: Default lifetime of the machine's tokens, in seconds. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveDefaultTokenTtl.

effectiveDefaultTokenTtl.description: The default token lifetime in seconds that Clerk is using, including its default.

name.description: Name of the machine.

secretKey.description: The machine secret key. Secret. Clerk can return it at any time, so it is also recovered when the machine is imported.

updatedAt.description: When the machine was last updated (RFC 3339).

defaultTokenTtl.description: Default lifetime of the machine's tokens, in seconds. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveDefaultTokenTtl.

clerk:index:OauthApplication.description: A Clerk OAuth application: lets Clerk act as an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect identity provider for a third-party app. Whether the application is public cannot be changed, so changing it replaces the application.

clientSecret.description: The OAuth client secret. Secret. Clerk returns it only when the application is created, so it is empty for an imported application.

consentScreenEnabled.description: Whether to show the consent screen to users. When unset Clerk applies its default, reported in effectiveConsentScreenEnabled.

effectiveConsentScreenEnabled.description: Whether the consent screen is enabled, including Clerk's default.

effectiveScopes.description: The scopes Clerk reports, which can be reordered and include implicit scopes.

name.description: Name of the OAuth application.

public.description: Whether this is a public OAuth application (one with no client secret). Changing this forces a new resource.

scopes.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes, for example "profile email". Clerk may reorder them and add implicit scopes such as offline_access; the scopes Clerk reports are in effectiveScopes and are not a change as long as every scope you asked for is present.

updatedAt.description: When the application was last updated (RFC 3339).

userInfoUrl.description: The OAuth user info endpoint URL.

clerk:index:Organization.description: A Clerk organization. Import with the organization ID (org_...). Requires the instance secret key; the slug only works when organization slugs are enabled in the Clerk Dashboard.

adminDeleteEnabled.description: Whether organization admins can delete the organization. Defaults to the instance setting when unset.

createdBy.description: ID of the user who creates the organization and becomes its admin. Only settable at creation; changing it forces a new resource.

maxAllowedMemberships.description: Maximum number of memberships allowed. Defaults to the instance setting when unset.

name.description: The display name of the organization.

privateMetadata.description: Private metadata as a JSON object string, visible only to the backend. Key order and whitespace do not matter.

publicMetadata.description: Public metadata as a JSON object string, visible to the frontend and backend. Key order and whitespace do not matter.

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier. Generated from the name when unset. Requires "Enable organization slugs" in the Clerk Dashboard (Configure > Organization settings).

updatedAt.description: When the organization was last updated (RFC 3339).

clerk:index:OrganizationDomain.description: A domain attached to a Clerk organization. The resource ID is <organizationId>/<domainId>; import with that composite ID (for example org_123/orgdmn_456). The organization and the name cannot be changed: changing either replaces the domain.

affiliationEmailAddress.description: The email address used for domain affiliation, when verification is by email.

enrollmentMode.description: Enrollment mode: manual_invitation, automatic_invitation, automatic_suggestion or enterprise_sso. Clerk requires a mode when a domain is created, so it is manual_invitation (the most restrictive) when unset. Left unset, the mode is unmanaged afterwards: refresh and import report Clerk's value in the state output and do not copy it into inputs.

name.description: The domain name, for example example.com. Changing this forces a new resource.

organizationId.description: ID of the organization. Changing this forces a new resource.

updatedAt.description: When the domain was last updated (RFC 3339).

verificationStatus.description: The domain's verification status, for example unverified or verified.

verified.description: Whether the domain is verified. Set true to verify the domain on creation without an email check. Reports the domain's current verification state.

Clerk requires a mode when a domain is created, so it is manual_invitation (the most restrictive) when unset. Left unset, the mode is unmanaged afterwards: refresh and import report Clerk's value in the state output and do not copy it into inputs.

name.description: The domain name, for example example.com. Changing this forces a new resource.

organizationId.description: ID of the organization. Changing this forces a new resource.

verified.description: Whether the domain is verified. Set true to verify the domain on creation without an email check. Reports the domain's current verification state.

clerk:index:OrganizationMembership.description: A user's membership of a Clerk organization. The resource ID is <organizationId>/<userId>; import with that composite ID (for example org_123/user_456). The organization and user cannot be changed: changing either replaces the membership. Only the role is updated in place.

membershipId.description: Clerk's own ID for the membership (orgmem_...). The Pulumi resource ID is <organizationId>/<userId>.

organizationId.description: ID of the organization. Changing this forces a new resource.

role.description: Role key to assign, for example org:admin or org:member.

roleName.description: Display name of the assigned role.

updatedAt.description: When the membership was last updated (RFC 3339).

userId.description: ID of the user to add as a member. Changing this forces a new resource.

organizationId.description: ID of the organization. Changing this forces a new resource.

role.description: Role key to assign, for example org:admin or org:member.

userId.description: ID of the user to add as a member. Changing this forces a new resource.

providerType.description: SAML provider type, for example saml_custom, saml_okta or saml_google. Changing this forces a new resource.

syncUserAttributes.description: Whether to sync user attributes from the identity provider on every sign-in.

clerk:index:SvixWebhook.description: The Svix webhook integration of a Clerk instance. Creating it provisions the Svix app that delivers Clerk webhooks; deleting it removes the app. An instance has at most one, so the ID is always svix_webhook. Import with the ID svix_webhook.

svixUrl.description: A fresh, short-lived URL of the Svix dashboard for managing webhook endpoints. Refreshing the resource generates a new one.

clerk:index:getAllowlistIdentifier.description: Look up a Clerk allowlist entry by ID or by identifier.

allowlistIdentifierId.description: The allowlist entry ID. Set either allowlistIdentifierId or identifier.

identifier.description: The allowlisted email address, phone number, web3 wallet or wildcard. Set either allowlistIdentifierId or identifier.

clerk:index:getApiKey.description: Look up a Clerk API key by ID, or by exact name within a subject. The secret is not returned.

apiKeyId.description: The API key ID. Set either apiKeyId, or name together with subject.

name.description: The exact API key name. Requires subject.

subject.description: The subject (user, organization, machine or SCIM ID) whose keys to search by name.

clerk:index:getApplication.description: Look up a Clerk application by ID through the Platform API (beta), including its instances and keys.

applicationId.description: The application ID to look up.

instances.description: The instances (environments) of the application, with their keys.

clerk:index:getApplicationSettings.description: Read the organization settings of the Clerk instance behind clerk:apiKey. The Backend API has no read endpoint, so this sends an empty update, which changes nothing.

adminDeleteEnabled.description: Whether organization admins can delete organizations.

creatorRole.description: The role assigned to the creator of a new organization.

domainsDefaultRole.description: The default role of users added through domain enrollment.

domainsEnabled.description: Whether domain-based organization enrollment is enabled.

maxAllowedMemberships.description: Default maximum number of memberships per organization.

maxAllowedPermissions.description: Maximum number of permissions per organization.

maxAllowedRoles.description: Maximum number of roles per organization.

clerk:index:getBlocklistIdentifier.description: Look up a Clerk blocklist entry by ID or by identifier.

blocklistIdentifierId.description: The blocklist entry ID. Set either blocklistIdentifierId or identifier.

identifier.description: The blocked email address, phone number or web3 wallet. Set either blocklistIdentifierId or identifier.

clerk:index:getDomain.description: Look up a domain of a Clerk application by application ID and domain ID through the Platform API (beta).

applicationId.description: The ID of the application the domain belongs to.

domainId.description: The domain ID (without the application prefix).

cnameTargets.description: The CNAME records to create in DNS for this domain.

frontendApiUrl.description: The frontend API URL of this domain.

isProviderDomain.description: Whether this is a provider domain.

isSatellite.description: Whether this is a satellite domain.

name.description: The domain name.

clerk:index:getInstanceConfig.description: Read the whole configuration of a Clerk instance through the Platform API (beta). The JSON can contain provider client secrets; handle the result accordingly.

applicationId.description: The ID of the Clerk application.

instanceId.description: The ID of the Clerk instance.

config.description: The instance configuration as a JSON object with sorted keys. It is a secret because instance configuration can contain provider client secrets.

configVersion.description: The version of the instance configuration.

clerk:index:getInstanceDomain.description: Look up a domain of the Clerk instance by ID or by name.

instanceDomainId.description: The domain ID. Set either id or name.

name.description: The domain name. Set either id or name.

clerk:index:getJwtTemplate.description: Look up a Clerk JWT template by ID or by name.

jwtTemplateId.description: The JWT template ID. Set either jwtTemplateId or name.

name.description: The JWT template name. Set either jwtTemplateId or name.

clerk:index:getMachine.description: Look up a Clerk machine by ID or by exact name. The secret key is not returned.

machineId.description: The machine ID. Set either machineId or name.

name.description: The machine name. Set either machineId or name.

clerk:index:getOauthApplication.description: Look up a Clerk OAuth application by ID, client ID or exact name. The client secret is not returned.

clientId.description: The OAuth client ID. Set exactly one of oauthApplicationId, clientId or name.

name.description: The application name. Set exactly one of oauthApplicationId, clientId or name.

oauthApplicationId.description: The OAuth application ID. Set exactly one of oauthApplicationId, clientId or name.

clerk:index:getOrganization.description: Look up a Clerk organization by ID or by slug.

organizationId.description: The organization ID (org_...). Set either id or slug.

slug.description: The organization slug. Set either id or slug.

clerk:index:getOrganizationDomain.description: Look up a domain of a Clerk organization by domain ID or by name.

name.description: The domain name. Set either organizationDomainId or name.

organizationDomainId.description: The domain ID: the bare Clerk ID, or the OrganizationDomain resource id ('<organizationId>/<domainId>'). Set either organizationDomainId or name.

organizationId.description: ID of the organization that owns the domain.

clerk:index:getOrganizationMembership.description: Look up a user's membership of a Clerk organization. The id is <organizationId>/<userId>.

clerk:index:getOrganizationPermission.description: Look up a Clerk organization permission by ID or by key.

key.description: The permission key, for example org:posts:create. Set either id or key.

organizationPermissionId.description: The permission ID (perm_...). Set either id or key.

clerk:index:getOrganizationRole.description: Look up a Clerk organization role by ID or by key.

key.description: The role key, for example org:admin. Set either id or key.

organizationRoleId.description: The role ID (role_...). Set either id or key.

clerk:index:getRedirectUrl.description: Look up a Clerk redirect URL by ID or by URL.

redirectUrlId.description: The redirect URL ID. Set either redirectUrlId or url.

url.description: The allowlisted redirect URL. Set either redirectUrlId or url.

clerk:index:getRoleSet.description: Look up a Clerk role set by ID or by key.

key.description: The role set key, for example role_set:default. Set either id or key.

roleSetId.description: The role set ID (rset_...). Set either id or key.

clerk:index:getSamlConnection.description: Look up a Clerk SAML connection by ID or by domain.

domain.description: The domain of the SAML connection. Set either id or domain.

samlConnectionId.description: The SAML connection ID. Set either id or domain.

clerk:index:getSvixWebhook.description: Look up the Svix webhook integration of the Clerk instance and get a fresh Svix dashboard URL. Fails when the integration has not been created.
